# Recipes

Short how-tos for working on this suite, each on its own. Read the one a task needs.

| Recipe | When |
| --- | --- |
| write-a-story-test.md | turning a story into a test |
| add-an-element.md | the story touches something no Elements constant covers |
| add-an-action.md | a click, a field, a check the page does not have yet |
| add-a-task.md | the story names a sequence ("sign up", "check out") |
| use-a-saved-page.md | reading a page the user saved; finding locators in it |
| add-a-page-type.md | a page the crawl did not read (behind a login, after a form) |
| wait-for-a-slow-page.md | a spinner, a late third-party widget, a test that clicks too early |
| forms-and-test-data.md | forms, passwords, test data, what must not run on the live site |
| frames-tabs-and-dialogs.md | payment widgets in iframes, new tabs, pop-ups |
| fix-a-failing-test.md | reading a failure; a broken locator or a site bug? |
| push-back-a-story.md | a story that can't be checked as written: the reason, and a rewrite to accept |
